items.title: fix(ui): preserve stopped-child signal outcomes
items.summary: fix(ui): preserve stopped-child signal outcomes Use the shared definitive PID check so an unreaped Linux child cannot make deferred shutdown report SIGKILL after the child exited normally. Retire the direct child PID once its exit is observed while retaining captured descendant cleanup and the existing 250 ms grace. A controlled scheduling pause reproduced the original signal mismatch; both capture modes pass after the fix. Validation passed 20 pressured invocations, all 31 UI cases, 40 PID-liveness cases, three original 48-file shard replays, types, lint, native erasability, and Codex P2 review. The full UI test command took 5.003 seconds under pressure. No assertions, deadlines, shared helpers, or permissions changed.
